assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: SINGLE modular 3D game environment prop reference image for image-to-3D reconstruction. Primary request: one straight 3-meter-wide abandoned municipal maintenance-yard fence/wall bay, 2.2 meters tall, about 0.25m deep, reusable end-to-end in a partly flooded industrial maintenance district reclaimed by vegetation and machines. Subject: TWO robust dark galvanized steel rectangular end posts with flat outer joining faces; low continuous weathered concrete plinth around 0.4m tall; opaque vertical ribbed corrugated metal infill, a few broad reinforcing horizontal rails. One small asymmetrical old repair patch integrated into panel, no loose accessories. STRUCTURE MUST BE A SINGLE STRAIGHT FLAT WALL BAY, not corner, not U-shape, no gate, no legs protruding forward. Functionally plausible bolt plates, mild chipped muted gray-green coating, localized ochre-red oxidation around fixings and lower edges, dark moisture staining at concrete base, believable worn thickness and silhouette. Realistic manufactured geometry and readable medium-scale detail suitable for a restrained cartoon-rendered Unity top-down extraction game; no baked cartoon outlines, no exaggerated fantasy shapes. Composition: exactly one complete standalone bay centered, full object entirely visible with generous margin, straight verticals, orthographic-like three-quarter view from modest 15 degrees above and 20 degrees to one side showing front face, right thickness and top. Plain neutral light gray studio background, uniform soft diffuse illumination, subtle contact shadow only. No surrounding walls, building, floor slab, scenery, grass, people, props, diagram, dimensions, text, signs, logos, numbers, border, watermark, multiple views or collage. Object must not be floating or cut off. Avoid wire mesh, razor wire, thin loose cables, see-through holes and busy tiny greebles. The result should communicate an old civilian industrial perimeter, not a military fortification.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE modular wall-mounted industrial service assembly, reference for image-to-3D. A 3 meter wide by 3 meter tall and 0.65 meter deep external utility service module for an abandoned municipal pump and electrical maintenance building. Single cohesive assembly: robust graphite steel rectangular mounting frame, left broad rectangular faded muted teal louvered ventilation enclosure with projecting top hood (main mass), right two thick vertical service pipes with curved elbows and prominent flange joints, one compact square shut-off valve housing and rugged cable conduit, connected to an upper horizontal support tray. Asymmetric but orderly believable construction. It is an exterior building attachment, not a building itself, not a shipping container or generator. BACK is a planar mounting frame only, do not include any background brick wall, no floor slab or surrounding building. Pipes and cabinets visibly attached to structural bars, no loose floating pieces. Large readable shapes suitable for a restrained cartoon-rendered top-down Unity game, realistic materials, realistic thickness, limited medium details. Weathered civilian industrial equipment from a partly flooded maintenance district: dark gray steel, desaturated oxidized teal paint, patches of beige primer, restrained rust at joints, subtle lower water staining. No neon, no fantasy, no guns, no people, no logos, labels, numbers, diagrams, dimensions, text, multiple views or collage. Isolated complete object centered with generous margins against neutral light gray studio background. Orthographic-like front three-quarter perspective, modest 15 degree elevation, 20 degree side angle showing depth and all attached components. Neutral diffuse lighting without dramatic baked shadows. High quality tangible game prop, not rough primitive blocks.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single abandoned municipal drainage sluice HEADWALL game prop for image-to-3D modeling. Design ONE compact grounded reinforced-concrete headwall assembly approx 5m wide, 1.5m deep, 2.8m tall. It belongs on the bank of a partly flooded old industrial maintenance district, not a giant dam. Center a deeply recessed CLOSED oxidized dark steel vertical sliding sluice gate, surrounded by thick asymmetrical concrete jambs and low slightly splayed wing walls attached at both ends. A robust small manual rack-and-handwheel mechanism at the top in a protective steel frame with physically attached supports. Flat rear contact plane, slightly beveled concrete edges, shallow aggregate chips, dark algae tide marks on lower third, ochre rust streaks descending below steel fasteners. Muted warm-gray concrete and desaturated slate-green metal, sparse safety yellow remnants only on mechanism. Clearly one practical water-control structure, monumental at human scale but no building roof, no staircase, no roadway or bridge, no large ground base beyond a narrow integrated sill. The gate is closed: no tunnel into a fake room, no water surface inside the mesh. Realistic designed forms with medium-scale details that read in a restrained cartoon-rendered top-down Unity extraction game, no black cartoon outlines, no fantasy machinery, no neon. Full object centered with generous margins, front three-quarter perspective from 15 degrees above and 25 degrees to one side, all construction readable. Neutral plain light-gray studio background, uniform soft illumination and minimal contact shadow. No environment, water, trees, people, loose props, labels, logos, text, diagrams, dimensions, multiple views, collage, watermark. Do not include the landscape; model ends at outer faces of wing walls.
